chunks: From him, from some of his companions, raising it, he said:
Nothing is given to a servant from the world except as a lesson, and nothing is withheld from him except as a trial.

key_terms.أُعْطِيَ: was given or granted to the servant
key_terms.اعْتِبَارًا: a lesson, admonition, or cause for reflection
key_terms.الدُّنْيَا: the worldly life and its material conditions
key_terms.زُوِيَ: was withheld, kept back, or restricted

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teach about wealth and deprivation in this world?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that both receiving worldly things and being deprived of them carry spiritual meaning. What is granted serves as a lesson and reflection, while what is withheld serves as a test of the servant's state and response before Allah.
